description: Close the loop on a settled Base Agent Swap Guard swap. Present the signed guard decision the agent executed under plus the swap transaction hash (and the approval transaction hash when held). Insight verifies the decision, requires the on-chain to/value/calldata to match the guarded approval and swap calls byte-for-byte, reconciles the observed ERC-20 input and output amounts against the guarded quote (amountInRaw, quotedAmountOutRaw, amountOutMinimumRaw, realized output-leg slippage vs the agent policy), and returns a signed BaseAgentSwapGuardSettlement bound to the decisionHash with explicit reason codes (SWAP_TX_REVERTED, SOURCE_AMOUNT_MISMATCH, REALIZED_SLIPPAGE_EXCEEDED, DECISION_EXPIRED_AT_CLOSURE, APPROVAL_TX_NOT_PRESENTED, and others). A decision that does not verify, or a transaction whose bytes differ from the guarded calls, is rejected. This is settlement evidence, not transaction authority, a price-correctness claim, or a guarantee of good timing.
name: settle_base_agent_swap_guard
